# Leading the Future of Agriculture

Helena Agri-Enterprises is one of the nation’s foremost agronomic providers of crop inputs,
application technology, manufacturing and data solutions. For nearly 70 years, our people have been
driven to providing sustainable solutions that help feed, clothe and fuel the world.

[Our Company][61]

## Our Expertise

Helena is a global leader in developing and manufacturing products for the agriculture, turf and
ornamental industry. These inputs are strengthened by our decades-long experience in precision
technology and data management. Explore our products and services to find the right fit for your
unique operation.

[Our Expertise][62]

[Helena Pillars]

## Our Advantage

Grounded by tradition yet empowered by innovation, Helena combines the power of relationships with
forward-thinking ideas. We work alongside our customers to meet evolving agronomic needs by
discovering and implementing new technology. Learn how we’re impacting agriculture and specialty
markets now and in the future.

[Our Advantage][63]

## Sustainability

At Helena Agri-Enterprises, sustainability drives everything we do. Guided by three pillars —
People, Products, and Knowledge — we focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions, supporting the
United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals, and fostering a culture of respect and opportunity.
Discover exactly how Helena is shaping a more sustainable future for agriculture and the communities
we serve.

[Sustainability][64]

## Stay in touch

Subscribe to Helena communications and receive the latest news and information impacting your
business.

[Subscribe][65]

the advantages of our business across the ag value chain and by maintaining access to the resources
and relationships with stakeholders needed to achieve our goals.

# Leading the Future of Agriculture

Helena Agri-Enterprises is one of the nation’s foremost agronomic providers of crop inputs,
application technology, manufacturing and data solutions. For nearly 70 years, our people have been
driven to providing sustainable solutions that help feed, clothe and fuel the world.

[Our Company][61]

## Our Expertise

Helena is a global leader in developing and manufacturing products for the agriculture, turf and
ornamental industry. These inputs are strengthened by our decades-long experience in precision
technology and data management. Explore our products and services to find the right fit for your
unique operation.

[Our Expertise][62]

[Helena Pillars]

## Our Advantage

Grounded by tradition yet empowered by innovation, Helena combines the power of relationships with
forward-thinking ideas. We work alongside our customers to meet evolving agronomic needs by
discovering and implementing new technology. Learn how we’re impacting agriculture and specialty
markets now and in the future.

[Our Advantage][63]

## Sustainability

At Helena Agri-Enterprises, sustainability drives everything we do. Guided by three pillars —
People, Products, and Knowledge — we focus on reducing greenhouse gas emissions, supporting the
United Nations' Sustainable Development Goals, and fostering a culture of respect and opportunity.
Discover exactly how Helena is shaping a more sustainable future for agriculture and the communities
we serve.

[Sustainability][64]

## Stay in touch

Subscribe to Helena communications and receive the latest news and information impacting your
business.

[Subscribe][65]

About

Syngenta

**We are a leading, science-based agriculture company, empowering farmers to meet the demands of
modern agriculture. Using cutting-edge innovation, we help farmers to grow resilient, healthy crops
that can feed a growing global population, while promoting sustainable farming practices that
protect and enhance our planet. Headquartered in Switzerland, we are a global agritech leader with
more than 30,000 employees across over 90 countries.**

a head, an abdomen and a thorax. In addition, all ants have six legs and bent antennae.

modern-day Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Israel, and Jordan, where humans first domesticated crops like
wheat, barley, and legumes. The development of farming allowed for food surpluses, which supported
population growth and the rise of complex societies. Over centuries, farming techniques evolved with
the invention of tools like the plow, irrigation systems, and crop rotation. The Industrial
Revolution in the 18th and 19th centuries brought mechanization, transforming agriculture into a
more efficient and large-scale enterprise. Today, farming continues to evolve with advancements in
biotechnology, precision agriculture, and sustainable practices, ensuring food security for a
growing global population.

***The History of Farming***
Farming, the backbone of human civilization, has a history that dates back over 10,000 years to the
Neolithic Revolution. This period marked the transition from nomadic hunter-gatherer societies to
settled agricultural communities. Early farming began in the Fertile Crescent, a region spanning
modern-day Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Israel, and Jordan, where humans first domesticated crops like
wheat, barley, and legumes. The development of farming allowed for food surpluses, which supported
population growth and the rise of complex societies. Over centuries, farming techniques evolved with
the invention of tools like the plow, irrigation systems, and crop rotation. The Industrial
Revolution in the 18th and 19th centuries brought mechanization, transforming agriculture into a
more efficient and large-scale enterprise. Today, farming continues to evolve with advancements in
biotechnology, precision agriculture, and sustainable practices, ensuring food security for a
growing global population.

***The History of Livestock Farming***
Livestock farming, the practice of raising animals for meat, milk, wool, and labor, has been
integral to human societies since the dawn of agriculture. The domestication of animals such as
cattle, sheep, goats, and pigs began around 10,000 years ago, coinciding with the rise of crop
farming. Early livestock farming provided a reliable source of protein, materials for clothing, and
draft animals for plowing fields. Over time, selective breeding improved the quality and
productivity of livestock. The Middle Ages saw the establishment of specialized farming systems,
such as pastoralism and mixed farming. The 20th century brought significant advancements in
veterinary medicine, nutrition, and breeding techniques, leading to increased efficiency and
production. However, modern livestock farming faces challenges related to environmental
sustainability, animal welfare, and climate change, prompting innovations in alternative proteins
and regenerative farming practices.

***The History of Poultry Farming***
Poultry farming, the raising of domesticated birds such as chickens, ducks, turkeys, and geese for
meat and eggs, has a rich history that spans thousands of years. Chickens, originally domesticated
in Southeast Asia around 6000 BCE, were initially valued for cockfighting and religious rituals
before their culinary importance was recognized. By the Roman Empire, poultry farming had become a
well-established practice, with chickens and eggs becoming dietary staples. The Industrial
Revolution marked a turning point, as technological advancements enabled large-scale production and
the development of specialized breeds for meat and egg production. The 20th century saw the rise of
intensive poultry farming, characterized by confined housing systems and automated feeding. Today,
poultry farming is a global industry, providing affordable protein to billions. However, it faces
scrutiny over animal welfare, antibiotic use, and environmental impact, driving demand for
free-range and organic alternatives.

***The History of Food Industries***
The food industry, encompassing the production, processing, packaging, and distribution of food, has
evolved dramatically over centuries. In ancient times, food processing was limited to basic methods
like drying, salting, and fermenting to preserve perishable items. The advent of agriculture allowed
for the cultivation of staple crops, which became the foundation of early food trade. The Industrial

## Welcome to BuyFromTurkey

## BFT Is Helping You To Connect With The Best Wholesale Material Suppliers From Turkey

BuyFromTurkey welcomes buyers from all over the world to its comprehensive marketplace, a wholesale
center for buyers to connect with suppliers,manufacturers, and wholesalers from around Turkey.

 

BFT was founded in 2020 by a team with over 20 years of experience in the international supply
chain, building market and construction fields. The desire to share the team members’ professional
experience in the field of construction and materials and the will to make known to the world the
quality materials produced in Turkey are the common denominator that brings these teams together and
this without any financial interest. We created BFT with 3 members, and now we are a team of 17
before having completed our first year of existence.

### CONVENIENT PRICES

In order to be even more efficient with our more than 20 years experienced team, we organize the
costs to benefit our customers in our work together with our suppliers.

### QUALITY PRODUCTS

With our suppliers who are experts in their field and have modern technologies, we offer
construction products to your service by changing your perspective on life, combining the latest
technology and architectural techniques.

### ONE-TO-ONE SUPPORT

We provide the web and transportation services that our customers need from a single point without
disruption and with our forward-looking, pioneering applications. Thus, we communicate in a short
time and for long-term.

### RELIABLE TURKISH SUPPLIERS

We look to the future with confidence thanks to our suppliers, who have adopted a sustainability
approach and have signed nature-friendly practices that contribute to the goal of leaving a better
world for future generations.

### DIRECT EXPORT

Thanks to our experience and our suppliers who are experts in their field, knowledge and references
in the field of foreign trade, we deliver goods and services to our customers on time and establish
profitable cooperation with our business partners.

### SEARCH FOR BUSINESS PARTNER

The ideal partner search in Turkey is a crucial step for the foreign companies. Depending on the
criteria of your company, our expert team starts working on making a list of potential local
companies

## Who we are

At CHS, our purpose is creating connections to empower agriculture. As a leading global agribusiness
and the largest farmer-owned cooperative in the United States, we serve customers in 65 countries.
Our diversified agronomy, grains, foods and energy businesses provide critical crop and livestock
inputs, market access and risk management services that help farmers feed the world.

guides and resources detailing the most effective ways to rid your property of unwanted visitors.

and recommendations of products that actually work; we will make your pest problems a thing of the

solutions. Having been in the pest control industry for decades, this website was born out of an
idea to inform and educate people on how to create rodent and insect free environments.

health. Read our guides and learn how to effectively control rodents using exclusion tactics, which
involves sealing cracks and other openings, before ensuring that your infestation is dealt with
effectively by placing traps or using secure bait boxes.

branded products such as Aakuko, Thandaj and Zusta amongst others.

fruits. Antibiotic boost and develop immune system of plants. Under this category we sell brand
product namely Retardo.

## Full-Service Amazon Consulting Services

Goat Consulting is an Amazon consulting agency that helps brands and manufacturers build profitable,
sustainable sales on Amazon. Whether you are launching on Amazon for the first time or scaling an
established catalog, our team of Amazon consultants manages your channel end-to-end, acting as your
outsourced Amazon department. From strategy and account management to advertising, merchandising,
fulfillment, product identification, troubleshooting issues, and reporting, every aspect of your
Amazon operation is covered.

[Amazon Management]

### Amazon Seller Central Account Management & Strategy

Every engagement starts with understanding your business, your products, and your goals on Amazon.
Your Goat Consulting Account Manager develops a tailored Amazon selling strategy and manages the
day-to-day execution on Seller Central and Vendor Central, including catalog management, case
resolution, Amazon Advertising, compliance monitoring, and ongoing optimization.

[ Learn More About Amazon Seller Consulting ][85]

### Amazon Keyword Research & Market Analysis

We use a research process that combines Amazon’s search data, competitive analysis tools, and our
proprietary customer survey methodology to identify the terms your customers actually use. This
research informs listing content, advertising campaign architecture, and competitive positioning.

[ Learn More About Amazon Keyword Research & Market Analysis ][86]

### Amazon Merchandising Services

Your account manager builds and maintains your complete Amazon merchandising presence, from product
detail pages and A+ Content to Amazon Storefronts, Brand Story modules, and variation structure. We
treat your Amazon catalog as a unified brand experience, not a collection of individual listings.

[ Learn More About Amazon Merchandising Services ][87]

### Amazon Catalog & Product Identification Services

Your account manager ensures a clean brand presence and Amazon catalog. We resolve GTIN, UPC, and
EAN issues, fix Amazon error code issues (8541, 8016, 8008, 8801 & more), handle GTIN reclaim and
hijacking cases, manage barcode strategy, including the 2026 commingling transition, and correct
product classification and category assignments across your catalog.

[ Learn More About Amazon Product ID Services ][88]

hijacking cases, manage barcode strategy, including the 2026 commingling transition, and correct
product classification and category assignments across your catalog.

Goat Consulting proactively monitors your catalog for compliance risks and manages the appeals
process when listings are suspended due to policy violations, product condition complaints, or
regulatory requirements. We handle restricted categories, CPC certifications, FIFRA/EPA policies,
and hazmat classifications, among other account health requirements.

[ Learn More About Amazon Compliance Services ][89]

### Amazon Advertising Management

As an Amazon Ads Verified Partner, we build and optimize advertising campaigns across Sponsored
Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and Video Ads. Our approach focuses on profitable
growth tracking TACoS (Total Advertising Cost of Sale) alongside Return on Ad Spend to ensure your
ad spend drives real revenue, not just clicks. We continuously optimize keyword targeting, bid
management, and campaign architecture based on your budget, margin requirements, and growth goals.

[ Learn More About Amazon Advertising Services ][90]

unauthorized sellers, counterfeit listings, and IP issues.

Your account manager develops the right fulfillment strategy for your business, whether that is FBA,

## Turn Market Complexity into Strategic Clarity

For decades, Kline and Company has helped organisations answer their most important growth
questions. Combining proprietary intelligence, deep industry expertise, and strategic advisory, we
help leaders identify opportunities, navigate uncertainty, and make confident decisions in complex
B2B markets.

## Let's Talk

[ Contact us ][50]

## Industries We Serve

Kline and Company provides insights across a diverse range of industries, including chemicals,
energy, beauty, and food and nutrition. Our expertise helps businesses navigate complex markets with
confidence.

We operate at the point where products are formulated, materials are developed, and markets are
defined, bringing unmatched depth across specialized and technically complex sectors.

## Chemicals and Materials

Expertise spanning specialty chemicals, ingredients, and advanced materials markets, supporting
decisions across highly complex value chains.

[ Learn More ][51]

## Energy

Recognized authority in lubricants, base oils, and adjacent energy markets, delivering the data and
insight that underpin industry decision-making.

[ Learn More ][52]

## Beauty and Wellbeing

Deep visibility across professional and B2B beauty markets, where formulation, channels, and
innovation intersect.

[ Learn More ][53]

## Food and Nutrition

Focused on ingredients, nutrition systems, and functionality—at the intersection of health,
sustainability, and performance.

[ Learn More ][54]

## **The Decisions We Help Solve**

##### WHERE INSIGHT BECOMES ACTION

Our work is structured around the critical decisions leadership teams face, not just the data behind
them.

## Where should we focus?

Identify the most attractive markets, segments, and opportunities across complex value chains.

## How is the market evolving?

Understand structural shifts, across supply, demand, technology, and regulation, before they impact
performance.

## What should we invest in next?

Prioritise innovation, portfolio strategy, and M&A with confidence backed by deep market evidence.

## How do we win in this space?

Translate insight into clear go-to-market, positioning, and growth strategies.

## Advisory

### From insight to strategy

Data alone doesn’t drive growth.

Kline and Company integrates deep market knowledge with strategic advisory to help clients act with
clarity, connecting market shifts to real commercial decisions.

Our advisory work builds on decades of industry expertise, proprietary data, and close engagement
with the markets we cover. This is how we ensure our recommendations are grounded, practical, and
actionable.

[Explore our advisory services][55]

## לידור אלמנטס

היא אחת החברות המובילות בישראל ליישום חומרים, מוצרים וטכנולוגיות בתחומי התעשיה והגנת הצומח. מזה 50
שנה, אנו מלווים חברות רבות בישראל, מהגדולות במשק ועד מיזמים ראשוניים, מייעצים במסירות ומספקים
פתרונות לצרכיהן ואתגריהן. אנו מייבאים, מוכרים ומפיצים חומרים ומוצרים באיכות הגבוהה ביותר, לרבות
פתרונות טכנולוגיים מתקדמים המשפרים יעילות ומסייעים ביצירת עתיד בר-קיימא. לספקינו הבינלאומיים, אנו
מציעים שירותים עסקיים נרחבים, פתרונות לוגיסטיים מקצה לקצה ותמיכה רגולטורית מלאה.

## איך נוכל לעזור?

אנחנו יודעים, לא קל למצוא את החומר, המוצר או הטכנולוגיה הנכונה. בשביל זה אנחנו כאן.
* ייעוץ בבחירת מוצר
  
  בואו ניצור משהו יחד. השאירו פרטים ונחזור אליכם בהקדם האפשרי:
  
  צירוף קובץ X pdf, docx, jpg, עד 3MB צרף שלח

## About

The Multiplex Group has been at the forefront of the agricultural sector since its inception in
1974. As industry leaders, we specialize in manufacturing and distribution of a comprehensive range
of agricultural inputs. Our portfolio encompasses fertilizers, pesticides, nutrients (both major and
minor), organic manure, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides, and bio-stimulants. The reach of Multiplex
products extend to more than 17 countries, including Japan, Korea, Ethiopia, Djibouti, Sri Lanka,
and various Arab nations.

Dedicated to the pursuit of the highest quality in agricultural yields, our devoted team of
scientists leverage cutting-edge technologies to develop innovative crop nutrition and plant
protection solutions at our facility. To know more about our advanced Research-and-Development

## 1974

## 1975

Over time, our company has evolved, expanding into various regions continuing to build on our
agricultural roots. Multiplex brand was registered in other states and Andhra Pradesh was the first
to market our products.

[Gallery Image]

## 1982

Multiplex Products extended its operation in Tamil Nadu. This geographical expansion enables the
company to tap new markets in the southern region enhancing its presence in one of India's key
states.

[Gallery Image]

## 1986

Understanding the need in the market, we focused on research, exclusive formulation, mass
production, and marketing of pesticides. Different varieties of seeds were introduced to the market
under the Multiplex Brand.

[Gallery Image]

## 1999

As Multiplex reaches its silver jubilee milestone, it reflects on a quarter-century of dedicated
service to the farming community. The company remains steadfast in its commitment to support and
uplift the agricultural sector.

[Gallery Image]

## 2000

We established a dedicated manufacturing facility for Zinc Sulphate in Peenya, Bangalore, alongside
a specialized production unit for organic manure, Biofertilizers, Bio activators, and Biopesticides.

[Gallery Image]

## 2003

Multiplex achieved a significant milestone by earning a prestigious organic certification from IMO,
a reputable certification body in Switzerland. This certification encompasses and validates the
entire production process of the company's Bioproducts.

[Gallery Image]

## 2004

Karnataka Agro Chemicals, Multiplex Biotech Pvt Ltd, and Multiplex Agricare Pvt Ltd obtained ISO
9001 and ISO 14001 certifications for their manufacturing facilities. This year, we introduced our
biofertilizers and biopesticides in liquid form, expanding our product range.

[Gallery Image]

## 2006

Multiplex Biotech Pvt Ltd was acknowledged by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research
(DSIR) for its pioneering work in advancing Agri-Biotechnology production methods.

[Gallery Image]

## 2012

We collaborated with a prestigious organization to open a new venture in the field of mechanized
paddy sowing and transplantation. The outcome of this project gave farmers substantial growth in
paddy cultivation based on improved yield both in quality and quantity.

[Gallery Image]

## 2013

In response to the urban organic farming trend, Multiplex Urban Green (MUG) introduced Krushi Garden
kits for home vegetable cultivation on terraces, balconies, and backyards. These kits include all
essential agriculture components and services.

[Gallery Image]

## 2015

The Multiplex Group introduced Multiplex Farming, a collaborative agricultural initiative that
transforms barren and semi-cultivated land. It also includes scientific analysis to manage soil and
crops comprehensively and farm management.

[Gallery Image]

## 2016

GPS Institute of Agricultural Management was established under the guidance and initiative of Dr. G.
P. Shetty's Agri Research and Educational Trust. This prestigious institute offers courses in Post
Graduate Diploma in Agricultural Management and Diploma in Agricultural Management (GPSIOAM).

[Gallery Image]

## 2017

In response to rising demand, Multiplex inaugurated a dedicated manufacturing facility in Ghaziabad.
This facility produces Micronutrients, Specialized fertilizers, Soil conditioners, and
Biofertilizers to cater to Northern India's agricultural needs.

The Center for Environmental and Regulatory Information Systems (CERIS), part of Purdue University’s
College of Agriculture and Department of Entomology, develops and maintains information systems that
support pesticide regulation, plant health, and environmental monitoring. Drawing on data from the
EPA, USDA, and state agencies, CERIS provides secure, web‑based databases used by organizations
worldwide and numerous participating states.

Since 1982, CERIS has streamlined the management of pesticide‑related information through shared
technical expertise, reduced operational costs, and a commitment to improving the user experience.
We are proud to support a diverse national community and look forward to partnering with you.

Discover the industry’s most powerful gateway to pesticide information. NPIRS (National Pesticide
Information Retrieval System) brings together federal and state pesticide data like never
before—giving researchers, regulators, and industry leaders a single, streamlined platform for fast,
accurate insights.

Access EPA pesticide labels, PDMS data, and state registration details in seconds. With NPIRS’s
advanced filtering tools, you can pinpoint exactly what you need—by product, active ingredient,
company, state, and more.

Whether you're making regulatory decisions, supporting compliance, advancing research, or managing
product portfolios, NPIRS delivers the reliable data you need to move forward with confidence.

  2025, with cages declining and barns remaining a small share. Source: Defra (2023, 2026). License:

  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even
  further.

# RISE

RISE (Responsible Industry for a Sound Environment) is the national trade association representing
manufacturers, formulators, distributors, and other industry leaders involved with specialty
pesticides and fertilizers. We serve as the collective voice of the specialty pesticide and
fertilizer industry.

[Member Login][12]

## Our Vision

#### **To support the creation of inspiring and healthy places to live, work, and play**

## Our Mission

#### **Promote and advance the specialty pest management and plant health industries through
#### collaboration, representation, and advocacy**

# Public Health

Responsible pesticide use contributes to the well-being of our citizens and our communities by
combating pests that spread disease such as West Nile virus, Zika virus and Lyme disease, among
others.

Responsible pesticide and fertilizer use creates ideal environments for trees and plants to thrive,
contributing to public well-being by reducing stress, encouraging physical activity and promoting
outdoor recreation.


# Environment

Our land, water and wildlife are arguably our nation’s most precious resources and need responsible
maintenance to thrive.

Specialty pesticide and fertilizer products – used responsibly – encourage the best from these
critical resources by helping control invasive species, enhancing tree and plant growth, creating
firebreaks, protecting wildlife, and promoting healthy landscapes and gardens.


# Quality of Life

Specialty pesticides and fertilizers, backed by science, improve our quality of life. They protect
us from pests that spread disease.

They provide playable, natural athletic fields and green spaces for us and our children. They
protect and enhance aquatic environments for humans and wildlife.


## Our Core Initiatives



#### Advocacy

On behalf of the specialty pesticide and fertilizer industry, we advocate at the federal, state, and
local levels to address evolving legislative and regulatory challenges and opportunities. [Learn
more →][13]



#### Regulation

As a highly regulated industry, we fully support a predictable, credible, and efficient regulatory
process within the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s Office of Pesticide Programs. [Learn more
→][14]



#### Research & Education

We amplify the collective voice of our industry, making it easy to access consistent, powerful
messaging about the value of our industry. [Learn more →][15]

## Join Us in Making a Difference

Become a part of RISE and support the creation of inspiring and healthy places to live, work, and
play. Learn more about what we do and join us in advocating for our industry.

# RISE

RISE (Responsible Industry for a Sound Environment) is the national trade association representing
manufacturers, formulators, distributors, and other industry leaders involved with specialty
pesticides and fertilizers. We serve as the collective voice of the specialty pesticide and
fertilizer industry.

[Member Login][12]

## Our Vision

#### **To support the creation of inspiring and healthy places to live, work, and play**

## Our Mission

#### **Promote and advance the specialty pest management and plant health industries through
#### collaboration, representation, and advocacy**

# Public Health

Responsible pesticide use contributes to the well-being of our citizens and our communities by
combating pests that spread disease such as West Nile virus, Zika virus and Lyme disease, among
others.

Responsible pesticide and fertilizer use creates ideal environments for trees and plants to thrive,
contributing to public well-being by reducing stress, encouraging physical activity and promoting
outdoor recreation.


# Environment

Our land, water and wildlife are arguably our nation’s most precious resources and need responsible
maintenance to thrive.

Specialty pesticide and fertilizer products – used responsibly – encourage the best from these
critical resources by helping control invasive species, enhancing tree and plant growth, creating
firebreaks, protecting wildlife, and promoting healthy landscapes and gardens.


# Quality of Life

Specialty pesticides and fertilizers, backed by science, improve our quality of life. They protect
us from pests that spread disease.

They provide playable, natural athletic fields and green spaces for us and our children. They
protect and enhance aquatic environments for humans and wildlife.


## Our Core Initiatives



#### Advocacy

On behalf of the specialty pesticide and fertilizer industry, we advocate at the federal, state, and
local levels to address evolving legislative and regulatory challenges and opportunities. [Learn
more →][13]



#### Regulation

As a highly regulated industry, we fully support a predictable, credible, and efficient regulatory
process within the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s Office of Pesticide Programs. [Learn more
→][14]



#### Research & Education

We amplify the collective voice of our industry, making it easy to access consistent, powerful
messaging about the value of our industry. [Learn more →][15]

## Join Us in Making a Difference

Become a part of RISE and support the creation of inspiring and healthy places to live, work, and
play. Learn more about what we do and join us in advocating for our industry.

[Get Involved with the Grassroots Network][16]

# Pesticide Environmental Stewardship

**The Pesticide Environmental Stewardship (PES) Website **is sponsored by the Center for Integrated
Pest Management. PES provides convenient access to information on proper pesticide handling. All
subject matter contained on this site has been reviewed and posted by Pesticide Safety Education
Program Coordinators and Specialists from the Cooperative Extension Service. This website is
intended for a national audience with links to state-specific information, where available. Crop
producers, pesticide dealers, commercial/professional applicators, and the general public will
benefit from the information presented in each topic, or module. **
**

**Topic titles are listed in the navigation drawer on the left.** “Click” on the topic title to view
the introduction. Upon landing on the introductory page, a list of subtopics will appear below
the topic title.

[**Resources to download and print – brochures, documents etc.**][34]

**Acknowledgments: **[**the creators and contributors to this website**][35]

PES content NEVER supersedes information on the pesticide label or in all applicable regulations.
Always read and follow label directions before buying or using a pesticide. Follow all appropriate
federal, state, tribal, and local regulations.

February 2026 is the Ninth Annual National Pesticide Safety Education Month. The purpose of National
Pesticide Safety Education Month is to reinforce core principles of safe pesticide use with many
audiences and raise awareness of and support for land-grant university Pesticide Safety Education
Programs (PSEPs).

the PES website.** Images or information at links may be subject to copyright. **PES content is
subject to change at any time, and may not always be up-to-date.** **Mention of brand names is for
educational purposes only.*

How does pest control insulation work?

[Pest control insulation][92] works by combining traditional insulation properties with
pest-repellent capabilities. This type of insulation is treated with materials that deter common
pests such as insects and rodents, creating an added layer of protection for your home. The treated
fibers disrupt the insects’ natural systems, making your home a less inviting environment for them.
At the same time, it functions as an effective insulator, maintaining energy efficiency and
regulating indoor temperatures.


One significant benefit of pest control insulation is that it provides long-term protection without
the need for constant reapplications or harsh chemicals. It can be installed in spaces like attics
and walls, where pests often enter and nest, reducing the chances of infestations. Additionally,
this insulation not only deters pests but also contributes to better air quality and a more
comfortable living environment, making it an all-round solution for home protection and insulation
needs.

How does pest control insulation work?

[Pest control insulation][92] works by combining traditional insulation properties with
pest-repellent capabilities. This type of insulation is treated with materials that deter common
pests such as insects and rodents, creating an added layer of protection for your home. The treated
fibers disrupt the insects’ natural systems, making your home a less inviting environment for them.
At the same time, it functions as an effective insulator, maintaining energy efficiency and
regulating indoor temperatures.


One significant benefit of pest control insulation is that it provides long-term protection without
the need for constant reapplications or harsh chemicals. It can be installed in spaces like attics
and walls, where pests often enter and nest, reducing the chances of infestations. Additionally,
this insulation not only deters pests but also contributes to better air quality and a more
comfortable living environment, making it an all-round solution for home protection and insulation
needs.

Is it safe to use pesticides for mosquito control?

When used correctly and according to the manufacturer’s instructions, pesticides for mosquito
control can be safe and effective. Many [mosquito control][93] products are designed to target the
pests specifically while minimizing risks to humans and pets. To ensure safety, these products
should only be applied in designated areas, kept away from food and water sources, and used in the
recommended quantities. Reading the label carefully and adhering to safety guidelines is crucial for
reducing potential hazards.

However, it’s important to consider proper handling and storage of pesticides to avoid unintended
exposure or misuse. For example, wearing protective gear during application and keeping children and
pets away from treated areas until the product has dried can significantly improve safety.
Additionally, some alternatives, like natural repellents or physical barriers, may be suitable for
those looking to reduce chemical exposure. Proper use and understanding of pesticides can help you
effectively manage mosquitoes while safeguarding your health and the environment.

What is backyard mosquito control?

Backyard [mosquito control][94] refers to the methods used to reduce or eliminate mosquito
populations in residential outdoor spaces. These measures are designed to make your yard more
enjoyable and less of a breeding ground for mosquitoes. Common strategies include removing standing
water, where mosquitoes lay their eggs, and maintaining your yard by trimming overgrown vegetation,
which can serve as shelter for adult mosquitoes. 

Other effective methods of backyard mosquito control often involve natural or chemical treatments.
Natural options include using citronella candles, planting mosquito-repellent plants, or introducing
beneficial insects like dragonflies that feed on mosquitoes. For chemical approaches, products like
outdoor sprays or larvicides can target mosquito larvae or adults. Combining multiple control
methods typically yields the best results, helping to create a mosquito-free environment for you and
your family to enjoy outdoor activities.

innovative solutions to today’s environmental challenges. We work together with our clients to

[More About Us][17]

## Our services…

[Engineering &
Design][18]


Shorten the timeframe for site remediation while reducing overall environmental project costs.

[Hazardous & Waste Evaluations][19]


Sample and test waste materials to determine proper handling, treatment, and disposal methods.

[Underground Storage Tanks][20]


Design, install, investigate, remove, correct, and close above ground and below ground tank systems.

[Voluntary Cleanup Program][21]


Detailed investigations of environmentally impacted properties from a cradle-to-grave approach.

[Environmental & Property Assessments][22]


Detailed site assessments in support of acquisition, merger, or divestment programs.

[Subsurface Fault Investigations][23]


Subsurface Fault Investigation services for owners & prospective owners of commercial properties.

[Oil & Gas Assessment & Site Cleanup][24]


Experienced oil and gas exploration and production of (E&P)-related environmental projects .

[Regulatory Permitting & Compliance][25]


Permitting and compliance for industrial activities, waste management, & remedial actions.

[Asbestos Containing Materials (ACM)][26]


Asbestos-Containing Material (ACM) consulting services for owners, & prospective owners, of
commercial properties.

### Simple

**Telegram** is so simple you already know how to use it.

### Powerful

**Telegram** has no limits on the size of your media and chats.

### Open

**Telegram** has an open [API][40] and source code free for everyone.

### Secure

### Social

**Telegram** groups can hold up to 200,000 members.

### Expressive

**Telegram** lets you completely customize your messenger.

modern agriculture. Using cutting-edge innovation, we help farmers to grow resilient, healthy crops
that can feed a growing global population, while promoting sustainable farming practices that
protect and enhance our planet. Headquartered in Switzerland, we are a global agritech leader with
more than 30,000 employees across over 90 countries.**

## About Alpha Agro Industries

Alpha Agro Chemicals is an agrochemicals manufacturer which has an innovative approach in dealing
with agriculture. We provide all sorts of bio-chemicals, pesticides, and solutions to a wide range
of crop-related problems.

Our wide portfolio of products helps in increasing crop yield, tackling all types of crop diseases,
and bringing great relief to the farmer’s difficulties. All possible efforts are made from our side
to find solutions for the problems arising due to changes in the climate.

We are Pune based Agrochemicals manufacturer, providing products all over Maharashtra. And we are
transparent about what we’re doing and the impact it is making.

We are an agrochemical company, offers various agricultural products and services.

As the food demand in India is increasing, we need to improve the manufacturing of seeds and
fertilizers. Our company makes various agrochemicals that help farmers to achieve their goal in crop
quality and to achieve better results.

guides and resources detailing the most effective ways to rid your property of unwanted visitors.

and recommendations of products that actually work; we will make your pest problems a thing of the
past.

solutions. Having been in the pest control industry for decades, this website was born out of an
idea to inform and educate people on how to create rodent and insect free environments.

shouldn’t. Causing no end of damage to your property and home they can also pose a risk to your
health. Read our guides and learn how to effectively control rodents using exclusion tactics, which
involves sealing cracks and other openings, before ensuring that your infestation is dealt with
effectively by placing traps or using secure bait boxes.

**WELCOME TO DHARMAJ CROP GUARD LIMITED Agro Chemicals Manufacturer**

Established in 2015, Dharmaj Crop Guard Limited is engaged in the business of manufacturing,
distributing, and marketing of a wide range of Agro chemical formulations such as insecticides,
fungicides, herbicides, plant growth regulator, micro fertilizers and antibiotic to the B2C and B2B
customers. We also engage in the marketing and distribution of agrochemical products under brands
in-licensed by us, owned by us and through generic brands, to Indian farmers through our
distribution network. We provide crop protection solutions to the farmer to assist them to maximize
productivity and profitability. We export our products to more than 38 countries in Latin America,
East African Countries, Middle East and Far East Asia. We sell our agrochemical products in
granules, powder and liquid forms our customers. Additionally, we manufacture and sell general
insect and pest control chemicals for Public Health and Animal Health protection.  With an aim to
offer a wide product portfolio across the Agri-value chain, we continue to expand our product
portfolio by introducing new products. We manufacture and sell various formulations of insecticides,
fungicide and herbicides, plant growth regulators, micro fertilizers and antibiotics.

## Full-Service Amazon Consulting Services

Goat Consulting is an Amazon consulting agency that helps brands and manufacturers build profitable,
sustainable sales on Amazon. Whether you are launching on Amazon for the first time or scaling an
established catalog, our team of Amazon consultants manages your channel end-to-end, acting as your

fulfillment, product identification, troubleshooting issues, and reporting, every aspect of your

Your Goat Consulting Account Manager develops a tailored Amazon selling strategy and manages the
day-to-day execution on Seller Central and Vendor Central, including catalog management, case
resolution, Amazon Advertising, compliance monitoring, and ongoing optimization.

We use a research process that combines Amazon’s search data, competitive analysis tools, and our

Yes. There are significant health risks associated with pest issues in homes and businesses. Apart
from pests damaging property and potentially harming your reputation, professional pest control is a
necessary investment to keep your environment safe.

### What happens during a pest control inspection?

A trained specialist conducts a full assessment of all accessible areas where existing or potential
pest infestations may occur. They use state-of-the-art devices to identify infestations even in
areas invisible to the naked eye. Following the inspection, they provide expert recommendations and
a tailored treatment plan.

## Turn Market Complexity into Strategic Clarity

For decades, Kline and Company has helped organisations answer their most important growth
questions. Combining proprietary intelligence, deep industry expertise, and strategic advisory, we
help leaders identify opportunities, navigate uncertainty, and make confident decisions in complex
B2B markets.

## Let's Talk

[ Contact us ][50]

## Industries We Serve

Kline and Company provides insights across a diverse range of industries, including chemicals,
energy, beauty, and food and nutrition. Our expertise helps businesses navigate complex markets with
confidence.

We operate at the point where products are formulated, materials are developed, and markets are
defined, bringing unmatched depth across specialized and technically complex sectors.

## Chemicals and Materials

Expertise spanning specialty chemicals, ingredients, and advanced materials markets, supporting
decisions across highly complex value chains.

[ Learn More ][51]

## Energy

Recognized authority in lubricants, base oils, and adjacent energy markets, delivering the data and
insight that underpin industry decision-making.

[ Learn More ][52]

## Beauty and Wellbeing

Deep visibility across professional and B2B beauty markets, where formulation, channels, and
innovation intersect.

[ Learn More ][53]

## Food and Nutrition

Focused on ingredients, nutrition systems, and functionality—at the intersection of health,
sustainability, and performance.

[ Learn More ][54]

## **The Decisions We Help Solve**

##### WHERE INSIGHT BECOMES ACTION

Our work is structured around the critical decisions leadership teams face, not just the data behind
them.

## Where should we focus?

Identify the most attractive markets, segments, and opportunities across complex value chains.

## How is the market evolving?

Understand structural shifts, across supply, demand, technology, and regulation, before they impact
performance.

## What should we invest in next?

Understanding the need in the market, we focused on research, exclusive formulation, mass

As Multiplex reaches its silver jubilee milestone, it reflects on a quarter-century of dedicated
service to the farming community. The company remains steadfast in its commitment to support and

We established a dedicated manufacturing facility for Zinc Sulphate in Peenya, Bangalore, alongside

Multiplex achieved a significant milestone by earning a prestigious organic certification from IMO,
a reputable certification body in Switzerland. This certification encompasses and validates the
entire production process of the company's Bioproducts.

[Gallery Image]

Karnataka Agro Chemicals, Multiplex Biotech Pvt Ltd, and Multiplex Agricare Pvt Ltd obtained ISO
9001 and ISO 14001 certifications for their manufacturing facilities. This year, we introduced our
biofertilizers and biopesticides in liquid form, expanding our product range.

crops comprehensively and farm management.

[Gallery Image]

Graduate Diploma in Agricultural Management and Diploma in Agricultural Management (GPSIOAM).

[Gallery Image]

Biofertilizers to cater to Northern India's agricultural needs.

College of Agriculture and Department of Entomology, develops and maintains information systems that
support pesticide regulation, plant health, and environmental monitoring. Drawing on data from the
EPA, USDA, and state agencies, CERIS provides secure, web‑based databases used by organizations
worldwide and numerous participating states.

Since 1982, CERIS has streamlined the management of pesticide‑related information through shared
technical expertise, reduced operational costs, and a commitment to improving the user experience.

Discover the industry’s most powerful gateway to pesticide information. NPIRS (National Pesticide
Information Retrieval System) brings together federal and state pesticide data like never
before—giving researchers, regulators, and industry leaders a single, streamlined platform for fast,
accurate insights.

advanced filtering tools, you can pinpoint exactly what you need—by product, active ingredient,
company, state, and more.

Whether you're making regulatory decisions, supporting compliance, advancing research, or managing
product portfolios, NPIRS delivers the reliable data you need to move forward with confidence.

* [
  [Stacked area chart of shares of egg production in the United Kingdom by housing system
  (free-range, cages, barns) from 1996 to 2025 where free-range rises from 10% in 1996 to 75% in
  2025, with cages declining and barns remaining a small share. Source: Defra (2023, 2026). License:
  CC BY.]
  
  Today
  
  ### Three-quarters of eggs produced in the United Kingdom are free-range
  
  Hannah Ritchie and Pablo Rosado
  
  Growing up in the United Kingdom in the 1990s and early 2000s, almost all the eggs in our
  supermarket came from battery hens, those raised in small wire enclosures.
  
  The living conditions in these cages are terrible. Birds get the space equivalent of an A4 sheet
  of paper. They don’t have the room to carry out their natural behaviors, such as nesting,
  perching, or dust bathing.
  
  That has changed in recent decades. You can see this in the chart, which shows the conditions
  under which eggs are produced in the UK. Free-range eggs have increased from just 10% to 75%.
  
  The use of caged hens has fallen, and the types of caged enclosures have also changed. Battery
  cages were banned in 2012, so legally, all cages since then have been “enriched” ones, which
  provide slightly more space. Still, these do not give hens the freedom and room they’d have in
  barns or free-range farms. Studies suggest that moving hens from enriched cages to cage-free
  systems reduces the time they spend in pain by more than half.
  
  And given that most eggs in the UK are now free-range, it’s possible to reduce this pain even

# RISE

RISE (Responsible Industry for a Sound Environment) is the national trade association representing
manufacturers, formulators, distributors, and other industry leaders involved with specialty
pesticides and fertilizers. We serve as the collective voice of the specialty pesticide and
fertilizer industry.

[Member Login][12]

## Our Vision

#### **To support the creation of inspiring and healthy places to live, work, and play**

## Our Mission

#### **Promote and advance the specialty pest management and plant health industries through
#### collaboration, representation, and advocacy**

# Public Health

Responsible pesticide use contributes to the well-being of our citizens and our communities by
combating pests that spread disease such as West Nile virus, Zika virus and Lyme disease, among
others.

Responsible pesticide and fertilizer use creates ideal environments for trees and plants to thrive,
contributing to public well-being by reducing stress, encouraging physical activity and promoting
outdoor recreation.


# Environment

Our land, water and wildlife are arguably our nation’s most precious resources and need responsible
maintenance to thrive.

Specialty pesticide and fertilizer products – used responsibly – encourage the best from these
critical resources by helping control invasive species, enhancing tree and plant growth, creating
firebreaks, protecting wildlife, and promoting healthy landscapes and gardens.


# Quality of Life

Specialty pesticides and fertilizers, backed by science, improve our quality of life. They protect
us from pests that spread disease.

They provide playable, natural athletic fields and green spaces for us and our children. They
protect and enhance aquatic environments for humans and wildlife.


## Our Core Initiatives



#### Advocacy

On behalf of the specialty pesticide and fertilizer industry, we advocate at the federal, state, and
local levels to address evolving legislative and regulatory challenges and opportunities. [Learn
more →][13]



#### Regulation

As a highly regulated industry, we fully support a predictable, credible, and efficient regulatory
process within the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s Office of Pesticide Programs. [Learn more
→][14]



#### Research & Education

We amplify the collective voice of our industry, making it easy to access consistent, powerful
messaging about the value of our industry. [Learn more →][15]

## Join Us in Making a Difference

Become a part of RISE and support the creation of inspiring and healthy places to live, work, and
play. Learn more about what we do and join us in advocating for our industry.

[Get Involved with the Grassroots Network][16]

# Pesticide Environmental Stewardship

**The Pesticide Environmental Stewardship (PES) Website **is sponsored by the Center for Integrated
Pest Management. PES provides convenient access to information on proper pesticide handling. All
subject matter contained on this site has been reviewed and posted by Pesticide Safety Education
Program Coordinators and Specialists from the Cooperative Extension Service. This website is
intended for a national audience with links to state-specific information, where available. Crop
producers, pesticide dealers, commercial/professional applicators, and the general public will
benefit from the information presented in each topic, or module. **

outdoor sprays or larvicides can target mosquito larvae or adults. Combining multiple control
methods typically yields the best results, helping to create a mosquito-free environment for you and
